operative_context: Subtotal, tax, and final amount handling must produce matching results when derived through different paths
exceptions: Pilot-specific currency presentation may require clarification before implementation, but must not create mismatches between customer-visible totals and underlying financial records
conflicts_or_obsolete: Display-friendly simplifications that produce visible mismatches between stored and presented totals are not acceptable
Operational display simplifications that cause customer-visible totals to diverge from underlying financial records must be avoided
notes: R69 targets consistency of monetary representation across all layers. PRIMARY evidence (E1-E5) establishes that values must align across calculation, storage, and display, and that currency/presentation rules must not override core pricing logic. E2 and E4 raise audit and pilot concerns about representation consistency. CONTEXT evidence (E8-E10) references related requirements (R80) and gaps (G61) on authoritative sources and rounding. E6 and E7 are supporting evidence from related documents. Key gaps remain around fraction handling, pilot currency rules, and rounding behavior—these should not be promoted to operative rules without explicit specification. Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: Monetary values must be represented consistently across calculation, storage, and user-facing display layers | User-facing totals must align exactly with persisted billing amounts | Currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency must be treated as strict accounting rules, not presentation-layer conventions
